note: Lane A derivatives only. NO inference was used for this batch - every asset is an ffmpeg camera transform of a real, sha256'd photograph. Manifest of record for derived/distribution media per agentic_ai_context/sops/GENERATED_MEDIA_SOP.md section 8. This is NOT an archive manifest: per MEDIA_ARCHIVE_PIPELINE.md, distribution != archive, and nothing here may be written back into raw/<farm>/ or uploaded to the YouTube farm channel.

policy.motion_extended_rule: motion == 'extended' => motion_seconds <= 4 AND not citable as a recorded event
policy.consent_rule: people_present == true AND lane == 'A' => consent_ref is not null before generation

outputs.note: Real photo inset over a blurred self-backdrop, not a crop. A true 9:16 crop of a 451px-tall source would need a 4.3x upscale.

assets.motion_note: Camera transform only. No frame content synthesized, so 7.3 (reversal caveat) is not engaged and no 'recorded at' claim is at stake.

label_drift_qc.method: tesseract --psm 11 on source vs extracted frames f0/f179
label_drift_qc.generated_f179_ocr: 81% Brazil Single Estate Chocolate | Saving our Amazon Rainforest, One Cacao at a time. | Manufactured by ... | Product of Brazil
label_drift_qc.pre_existing_warn: Label reads '81% Brazil Single Estate' and never names the farm. WARN carried forward unchanged; fix is a caption naming the estate, not an edit to the bar.
